name: Kestrel Community Net
blurb: Volunteer-run mesh network with an open guest gateway.
banner: Run by volunteers. Be kind to the bandwidth.
Node meetings: first Saturday of the month, Ngong Road hub.

content.text:
KESTREL WIRELESS COOPERATIVE · HOW TO JOIN

1. Come to the Thursday meeting at the hall. Bring your router if you have one.
2. A volunteer will put a node on your roof. You pay for the cable and nothing else.
3. Your node carries your neighbours' traffic and theirs carries yours. That is the whole idea.

Use what you need. If the ledger says you use far more than you carry, the committee will come and talk to you.

Volunteers’ meeting, February. Eleven present.

The committee proposes charging for bandwidth over the fair-use line. Three people object. One says it is not fair on the estate. One says it is not fair on the volunteers. One says nothing and writes it all down, and that one is the treasurer.

Vote deferred. Again.

POST-MORTEM, January outage. Cause: a power strip. Fix: a power strip. Lesson: we have eleven volunteers and one working power strip.

Action: buy a second power strip. Owner: unassigned. Due: when someone puts their name down.
